I am old now, 62 years, and my body does not do what it once did. This rice plot is small but the land here near the mountain is good for rice if there is water. I will put a little fertilizer — maybe half a bag of urea — because rice needs it to give a proper harvest, and I will add manure from my few animals. I keep my own seed from last season; the improved seed from the shop costs too much and I do not always trust it. For the planting and weeding I will call my daughter-in-law and some neighbors to help, and pay a few days of labor for the land preparation because I cannot do it alone.
